No TA/DA will be paid for certificate verification or for joining the apprenticeship training. Canvassing in any form is liable to make you ineligible.

content_sections.heading: About the Organisation
content_sections.text: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) is a Government of India undertaking. This recruitment is run by BHEL Thirumayam and is published in a circular signed by the Senior Manager (HR). The circular says it follows a notification of the Board of Apprenticeship Training (Southern Region), under which BHEL gives one year of apprenticeship training to fresh Diploma holders.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The circular lists 10 training vacancies for 2026-2027 across four disciplines. The number of vacancies is tentative. It may increase or decrease in all or any of the branches depending on the requirement, at the absolute discretion of the management. Of the training vacancies, 19%, 1%, 27%, 10% and 4% are reserved for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), EWS and Physically Challenged (PwD) candidates respectively. The circular gives these as percentages only, not as seat numbers for each discipline. Reservation for dependents of regular employees (Serving/Retired/Deceased) is as per company rules.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: All four disciplines have the same qualification rule. Only candidates who completed their full-time Diploma course in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026 are eligible. A Diploma completed through Distance Learning, Part Time, Correspondence or Sandwich courses will not be considered. Candidates must be registered on the MHRD NATS 2.0 portal for Technician apprentices. Only candidates with a BOAT/NATS 2.0 Student Enrolment Number will be considered. Candidates who have already completed, or are now undergoing, apprenticeship training in any other establishment under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act 1973. Students with work experience of one year or more. Only candidates who passed their qualifying examination from recognized academic institutions in the state of Tamilnadu will be considered for selection. If no candidates from Tamilnadu are available for a branch, the vacancies in that branch will be filled with other candidates as per procedure. For General Candidates the age limit is minimum 18 and maximum 27 years as on 01.11.2026. The following relaxations apply to the upper age limit: Candidates selected as apprentices must meet the minimum physical fitness standards specified in the Apprentices Act, Clause 4 of Apprenticeship Rule 1992, and any amendments to it. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility rules of each discipline.

rows.post: Technician Apprentice (Mechanical, Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, Civil)
rows.essential_qualification: Pass in High School and Diploma Pass as a regular full time candidate in the last Five years from a Govt. recognized institute, with 60% marks for UR/OBC (NCL)/EWS candidates and minimum 50% marks for SC/ST candidates.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship training lasts one year from the date of joining, under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act 1973. A stipend of Rs. 10,900/- per month (Consolidated) is paid for the entire training period. This rate is the same for all four disciplines. BHEL has no obligation to offer employment to apprentices once the training at BHEL Thirumayam is complete. An apprentice also cannot claim a right to employment on the ground of having completed the apprenticeship.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BHEL Thirumayam Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Only online applications will be accepted. The application window runs from 26 November 2026 to 10 December 2026. Annexure-1 of the circular gives these steps: Register on the Ministry of Education/GOI portal ( https://nats.education.gov.in ). Note down your 12/16-digit Student Enrolment Number, because you need it to apply on the BHEL portal. Go to the BHEL Trichy portal ( https://trichy.bhel.com ) and click "Apprenticeship Application Portal (THIRUMAYAM)". Click "Register" from the menu, read the instructions and accept them by clicking "I agree". Fill in the registration form and click "REGISTER". A One Time Password (OTP) will be sent to your registered email ID and mobile number. Create a new password using the OTP, then log in to the portal with it. Fill in the application form and upload scanned copies of the documents listed below, in the sizes the portal shows. Submit the application and save a copy. You must produce this copy at document verification. Latest colour passport size photograph Candidate's signature 10th Standard mark sheet Consolidated mark sheet of the prescribed educational qualification Community Certificate (SC/ST/OBC (NCL), EWS, PwD certificate). OBC (NCL) and EWS certificates must follow the latest government guidelines and in any event be not more than one year old. Aadhaar card Screenshot of the candidate's profile home page on the NATS portal ( https://nats.education.gov.in ), showing the 12/16-digit portal registration number Front page of the bank passbook as uploaded on the NATS portal. The account should be Aadhaar seeded and DBT enabled. Upload only the documents that apply to you. Blurred, edited or incorrect documents will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is based on meeting the conditions of the notification. A merit list will be drawn up from the marks secured in the qualifying examination. If two candidates have the same marks, the older candidate will be preferred. The circular does not mention a written test or an interview. The list of eligible candidates for document verification and apprentice training will be published on https://trichy.bhel.com (Our services → Apprenticeship Application Portal (THIRUMAYAM)) or sent through e-mail/SMS alerts. Candidates must bring the copy of their online application to document verification.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications that are incomplete, that do not meet the eligibility criteria, or that are sent in any mode other than online will be treated as "Rejected". You must have an active email ID and mobile phone number that stay valid for at least the next one year. All future communication will take place only through the website, e-mail or SMS alerts. Check https://trichy.bhel.com and your registered e-mail regularly. You are wholly responsible for the information in your online application, so check it is correct before final submission. No TA/DA will be paid for certificate verification or for joining the apprenticeship training. Canvassing in any form is liable to make you ineligible.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BHEL Thirumayam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 tentative Technician Apprentice vacancies: 3 in Mechanical, 2 in Electronics & Communication, 3 in Electrical & Electronics and 2 in Civil.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BHEL Thirumayam Technician Apprentice training?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 10 December 2026. It opened on 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the BHEL Technician Apprentice seats?
faq.answer: You need a pass in High School and a Diploma passed as a regular full-time candidate in the last five years from a Govt. recognized institute, with 60% marks for UR/OBC (NCL)/EWS and 50% for SC/ST. Only Diplomas completed in 2022 to 2026 are accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BHEL Thirumayam Technician Apprentice?
faq.answer: For General Candidates the age limit is minimum 18 and maximum 27 years as on 01.11.2026. The upper limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL) and 10 years for PwD candidates with at least 40% disability.

faq.question: Q5. What stipend will BHEL Thirumayam apprentices get?
faq.answer: Apprentices get a stipend of Rs. 10,900/- per month (Consolidated) for the full one-year training period.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for BHEL Thirumayam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: First register on https://nats.education.gov.in to get your 12/16-digit Student Enrolment Number. Then apply on https://trichy.bhel.com through the Apprenticeship Application Portal (THIRUMAYAM). Only online applications are accepted.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates will be selected from a merit list based on marks in the qualifying examination. If marks are tied, the older candidate is preferred. Shortlisted candidates then attend document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Tamil Nadu apply?
faq.answer: Only candidates who passed the qualifying examination from institutions in Tamilnadu will be considered first. Other candidates are considered for a branch only if no Tamilnadu candidates are available for that branch.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply if I have already done an apprenticeship or have work experience?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who have completed or are undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act 1973 cannot apply, and neither can those with one year or more of work experience.

faq.question: Q10. Will BHEL give a permanent job after the apprenticeship?
faq.answer: No. BHEL has no obligation to offer employment after the one-year apprenticeship, and apprentices cannot claim employment because they completed the training.
